                      count(*) FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND NOT ("phone_number" IS NULL)),coalesce(sum("__ledger_group_count") FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND NOT ("phone_number" IS NULL)),0),
                      coalesce(sum("__ledger_group_count"-1) FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND NOT ("phone_number" IS NULL)),0),count(*) FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND ("phone_number" IS NULL)),
                      coalesce(sum("__ledger_group_count") FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND ("phone_number" IS NULL)),0)
                      FROM (SELECT "phone_number",count(*) AS "__ledger_group_count" FROM "marts"."twilio__number_overview" GROUP BY "phone_number") grouped_keys
